diagram_previews.alt: Cross-section of the Sun as a shaded circle with centre O; the blue tangent lines at the top point P and bottom point P' bound a slab. Planet Q1 in red lies on the dashed line through O inside the slab, seen from neither point; the other planets lie above the top tangent (visible from P) or below the bottom tangent (visible from P').
